svg.title: Quantum sensitivity
svg.desc: Mean response and context switches versus quantum for Round Robin and AQS in five workload classes.
svg.text: Step 3: quantum sensitivity, Round Robin versus AQS (base quantum)
Mean over 10 trials with 95% CI bars, switch cost 1 tu. For AQS the x value is the base quantum; the quantum then adapts within [min(2, x), max(12, x)].
